data.text: My family taught me to leave enough fish for the next season. With 100 tons in the lake, we can catch 50 tons between us and leave 50 to double back to 100. I propose 10 tons each this month—that’s $10,000 apiece, and we can keep earning that every month if we stick together. I’ll commit to 10 tons. Shall we all agree, then review the catches together afterward? John, what do you think?
